en.name: .300 Blackout TAC-TX
en.description: The .300 Blackout TAC-TX is a popular choice for hunting and defense applications. The TAC-TX has an all-copper design and a specially engineered nose cavity. This results in rapid expansion, devastating energy transfer and weight retention. Manufactured by Barnes.

po.name: .300 Blackout TAC-TX
po.description: A .300 Blackout TAC-TX é uma escolha popular para caça e defesa. A TAC-TX tem projétil todo de cobre e uma cavidade na ponta especialmente projetada, o que resulta em expansão rápida, transferência de energia devastadora e retenção de massa. Fabricada pela Barnes.

ru.name: .300 Blackout TAC-TX
ru.description: Патрон .300 Blackout (7.62x35мм) TAC-TX — популярный выбор для охоты и обороны. TAC-TX имеет цельномедную конструкцию и специально спроектированную полость в носовой части, что дает быстрое раскрытие, разрушительную передачу энергии и сохранение массы. Производитель — Barnes.

en.name: .300 Blackout TCX
en.description: The .300 Blackout TCX (Total Copper X-panding) is a popular choice for hunting and defense applications. It has consistent penetration that meets or exceeds FBI standards, and expansion that reliably outperforms typical JHP (Jacketed Hollow Point) projectiles. Manufactured by Lehigh Defense.

po.name: .300 Blackout TCX
po.description: A .300 Blackout TCX (Total Copper X-panding) é uma escolha popular para caça e defesa. Tem penetração consistente que atende ou supera os padrões do FBI e expansão que supera de forma confiável os projéteis JHP (Jacketed Hollow Point) comuns. Fabricada pela Lehigh Defense.

ru.name: .300 Blackout TCX
ru.description: Патрон .300 Blackout (7.62x35мм) TCX (Total Copper X-panding) — популярный выбор для охоты и обороны. Обладает стабильной пробиваемостью, отвечающей стандартам ФБР или превосходящей их, и раскрытием, которое надежно превосходит обычные пули JHP (Jacketed Hollow Point). Производитель — Lehigh Defense.
